skill.name: copy-editing
skill.description: A structured copy-editing workflow for reviewing and improving existing marketing copy through focused editing passes.
skill.summary: Improve marketing copy with seven focused editing sweeps.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious code patterns in this prompt-only skill. Manual context review found no prompt-injection attempt, data exfiltration intent, network behavior, filesystem access, or executable behavior.

content.user_title: Improve Marketing Copy with Editing Sweeps
content.value_statement: Marketing copy often loses clarity, proof, or conversion focus during revision. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through seven focused editing passes.
actual_capabilities: Runs seven focused sweeps for clarity, tone, benefits, proof, specificity, emotion, and risk.
Identifies vague claims, unsupported assertions, weak calls to action, filler words, and tone shifts.
Recommends specific edits while preserving the original message and author voice.
Provides quick word, sentence, and paragraph checks for faster reviews.
Uses a checklist and context questions to support collaborative copy revisions.
limitations: Does not write a full campaign from scratch; it edits existing copy.
Needs target audience, goal, brand voice, and available proof for best results.
Cannot verify external claims, links, or statistics without supplied evidence.
May suggest risk reducers only when they fit the real offer and policy.

use_cases.title: Review a SaaS Landing Page
use_cases.description: Find unclear claims, weak proof, and CTA friction before a campaign launch.

use_cases.title: Polish Email Campaign Copy
use_cases.description: Tighten subject lines, benefit statements, and message flow while keeping the intended voice.

use_cases.title: Tighten Client Drafts
use_cases.description: Give structured feedback and specific edits that clients can review and approve.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Copy Proofread
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for a short draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this copy for grammar, clarity, and filler words. Keep the message and voice intact. Copy: [paste copy]

prompt_templates.title: Tone and Benefit Sweep
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review for positioning and voice.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this copy for voice consistency and benefit clarity. Flag tone shifts, feature-only claims, and unclear audience value. Audience: [audience]. Goal: [goal]. Copy: [paste copy]

prompt_templates.title: Full Seven-Sweep Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the full seven-sweep copy-editing process on this copy. Return findings by sweep, then give prioritized edit recommendations. Audience: [audience]. Desired action: [action]. Brand voice: [voice]. Copy: [paste copy]

prompt_templates.title: Conversion Revision Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review with proof and policy constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this conversion copy using the seven sweeps. Preserve the core offer, avoid unsupported claims, and only suggest proof or risk reducers from the notes. Proof available: [proof]. Constraints: [constraints]. Copy: [paste copy]

output_examples.input: Our innovative platform helps businesses optimize workflows.
output_examples.output: Suggested edit: Cut reporting work by four hours a week with automated workflow dashboards. Reason: the edit replaces vague claims with a concrete outcome.
Risk check: The CTA is clear but unsupported. Add a lower-risk next step, such as a free trial, only if the offer supports it.

output_examples.input: Trusted by thousands of customers worldwide.
output: Suggested edit: Name the customer count, segment, or review source if available.
Fallback: Use a softer claim if proof is not available.

best_practices: Provide the goal, audience, desired action, and brand voice before requesting edits.
Ask for findings by sweep before approving rewritten copy.
Supply proof sources, customer details, and policy constraints for claims.
anti_patterns: Asking for a full rewrite without sharing the original copy or audience.
Accepting stronger claims without confirming they are true.
Using emotional pressure or risk reducers that misrepresent the offer.

faq.question: What kind of copy is this for?
faq.answer: It is designed for marketing and conversion copy, including pages, emails, ads, and product messaging.

faq.question: Can it write new copy from scratch?
faq.answer: It is best for editing existing copy. Use a copywriting workflow first when you need a new draft.

faq.question: How does the seven-sweep method work?
faq.answer: It reviews one dimension at a time, including clarity, tone, benefits, proof, specificity, emotion, and risk.

faq.question: Will it preserve brand voice?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide voice guidance or sample copy. It focuses on improving the draft without changing the core message.

faq.question: Can it fact-check marketing claims?
faq.answer: It can flag proof gaps, but it needs supplied evidence to verify statistics, testimonials, or external claims.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
